climbing.title: Climbing
climbing.intro: A few hard days and ambitious projects.

accomplishments.title: Free climb of the Northwest Ridge of Bugaboo Spire
accomplishments.description: Took 21 hours camp-to-camp because of the melted out B-S Col.

accomplishments.title: Free Climb Castleton Tower
accomplishments.description: Can you believe they put a car up here?

accomplishments.title: Aid climb of Moonlight Buttress
accomplishments.description: To celebreate my buddy's 40th! Zion is incredibly beaufitul in January.

accomplishments.title: Aid climb of The Nose (attempt)
accomplishments.description: Bailed because it is really hard, and because of inexperience.

accomplishments.title: The Seven Steps of Paradise (attempt)
accomplishments.description: I just bonked, it's a slog to get out there! I skied most of the steps anyway.

accomplishments.title: Grand Daddy Couloir
accomplishments.description: Possibly the best ski descent of my life.

accomplishments.title: Store Austanbotntind (attempt)
accomplishments.description: Completed two thirds of the descent in Norway. Crazy icy conditions prevented us from skiing all the way from the top.

accomplishments.title: Wapta Traverse (attempt)
accomplishments.description: Bailed for incoming weather, which would worsen avalanche conditions.

accomplishments.title: STS Couloir, 8812, and Video Peak
accomplishments.description: There's always snow in the pass!
